entities.summary: Charles P. Freeman is an English author specialising in popular histories of ancient Greece and Rome. He has written numerous books on the ancient world including The Closing of the Western Mind: The Rise of Faith and the Fall of Reason. In 2003, he was elected a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts.
